rich_narrative.summary: Muslim Hands USA provides emergency relief and humanitarian aid to people in crisis zones like Gaza and Sudan. The organization focuses on disaster relief and human development for needy populations. In FY2024, the charity reported <cite id="3">a Total Revenue of $2,027,541</cite>, reflecting early-stage revenue expansion. However, financial records show a <cite id="1">Program expense ratio of 43.7%</cite> in FY2024, leaving over half of its budget for administrative and fundraising expenses. Muslim Hands USA is a <cite id="2">zakat-eligible organization</cite> that aligns closely with Islamic giving traditions, offering direct assistance across multiple crisis areas.
